name: Block ID Layer Lookup Table
aliases: Block ID to Layer Lookup Table
definition: A technique to classify block IDs into mesh layers (opaque, water, transparentSolid) using a direct array lookup instead of hash sets, optimizing the inner meshing loop.
summary: The Block ID Layer Lookup Table is a memory optimization that replaces slow hash-based lookups with direct array indexing to classify block IDs into mesh layers, offering O(1) access for voxel meshing.
